patent.title: 一种基于产品原型界面的文档生成方法和装置
assignees: 远光软件股份有限公司
patent.family_note: Ordinary CN invention (not an award textbook case). Later sibling-theme filing CN113407598A generates需求文档 from interface code rather than from prototype-element remarks + screenshots; do not conflate.

knowledge_origin.description: Public sources confirm Yuanguang inventorship/assignee but do not reconstruct whether this filing originated as product-roadmap work for 天鹿 versus a broader internal tooling R&D track.

technology.problem: Manually assembling project requirement documents from prototype screens — adjusting text, screenshots, and formatting for each product iteration — is repetitive and slows product cycles.
technology.mechanism: Claimed method/apparatus: upload a standard Word document template; add remarks on prototype UI elements; cache remarks as JSON; capture prototype screenshots via HTML5 canvas into binary/JSON; use a Node.js plugin to fill text and images into the template to auto-generate a project requirement document.
technology.comparison_baseline: Manual copy/paste of prototype notes and screenshots into Word templates without JSON-ordered auto-fill and canvas capture pipeline (as described in the patent background).

value_carriers.name: 远光天鹿 / Xdeer 原型与体验设计平台（候选价值载体，映射未确认）
value_carriers.description: Public product exists (marketplace listing, ops guide, company blog) in the same prototype-tooling domain. Patent embodiment mentions www.xdeer.cn, but no official disclosure reviewed names ZL202010574036.6 / CN111859886B as an exact implemented feature of shipped 天鹿. Keep link unknown.

gaps.description: No public regulated disclosure, license schedule, or official Yuanguang product document reviewed names ZL202010574036.6 / CN111859886B as implemented in 远光天鹿. Patent embodiment URL (xdeer.cn) is not treated as E3 official mapping.
